latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Maker from Photos — Turn Photos into MP4 slideshow videos.

- Turn batches of JPG, PNG, HEIC, or WEBP photos (up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 videos in 30-60 seconds.
- Automatic backend connection and session handling, including anonymous token support for new users.
- Supports keyword-based workflow routing: upload, export, balance checking, and editing.
- Built-in error handling for credits, session state, and file types.
- Downloadable results ready for social media and marketing use.
